item.title: National cricket team announces squad for upcoming series
item.description: Selectors named a squad that includes three uncapped players. The coach said the series is a chance to test bench strength. Training camps begin next week. The first match is scheduled at the end of the month.

item.title: Marathon organisers introduce sustainability measures
item.description: Organisers of a city marathon announced reusable cups and better waste sorting. Volunteers will guide runners at recycling points. The event expects record participation. Registration closes soon.
